page.overview:
Who is Y'rhul Nunh?

Y'rhul Nunh is a character from Final Fantasy XIV. A gleaner from Sharlayan, he is the father of twelve Miqo'te women, most prominently Y'shtola Rhul of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.

While most Seeker of the Sun tribes are large but close-knit family groups centered around a breeding male, or "nunh", the Y tribe was different. Because of Y'rhul's job as a gleaner he often traveled all across the world. During his travels he met up with several women, and fathered children with them. As a result his daughters, numbering twelve in total, were scattered and saw their half-sisters more as distant relatives than siblings.

Shortly after Endwalker, Y'rhul died on an expedition to Nagxia while he had been gathering literature for his job as a gleaner. Despite being perfectly healthy, he succumbed to a disease local to Nagxia. Y'nazqha took it the hardest as she had been with him when he died. She was forced to mourn him alone, because the disease couldn't be allowed to spread and so his corpse had to be cremated there instead of being brought home to Sharlayan. Y'nazqha cast his ashes out over the Ruby Sea so that he could still travel the world along the ocean currents.

When Y'nazqha returned home she spread the word of Y'rhul's death to all of his twelve daughters, and they gathered together to mourn him and receive books that he had gathered for each of them as a gift. Of note, Y'shtola received a Mhachi grimoire about opening gates to the Void, while Y'nazqha received a storybook of Corvosi fairy tales.
